quarterly_data.signal: Power segment project backlog was $2.7 billion as of January 31, 2026, versus $1.3 billion as of January 31, 2025; the consolidated project backlog consisted substantially of Power segment projects. Argan estimates that approximately 38% of its remaining unsatisfied performance obligations (RUPO) as of January 31, 2026 will be recognized as revenue during the next 12 months, with substantially all of the remainder recognized within 12 to 24 months thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: Power segment backlog $2.7 billion (January 31, 2026) vs $1.3 billion (January 31, 2025); ~38% of RUPO in the next 12 months

quarterly_data.signal: Power segment revenues increased by 9.2%, or $63.5 million, to $756.5 million for Fiscal 2026 from $693.0 million for Fiscal 2025, primarily from increased construction activity on the 405 MW Midwest Solar Project, the 700 MW Combined-Cycle Project and the commencement of several recently started gas-fired projects, partially offset by decreased activity on the Trumbull Energy Center, the Midwest Solar and Battery Projects, the Louisiana LNG Facility, the ESB FlexGen Peaker Plants and the Shannonbridge Power Project.
